answer.origin: Finance.yahoo.com, in an article published 2026-07-01, reporting an NN, Inc. announcement said to have been made in late June 2026; the announcement’s exact date is not supplied.
answer.note: NN reportedly plans to add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN reportedly said the new capacity was 100% pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. This is a supplier-capacity and potential demand signal relevant to NVDA’s data-center supply chain: if the expansion is delivered and the awards serve NVIDIA-related programs, it could support availability of liquid-cooling components for AI racks. It does not establish that NVIDIA is the award customer, that NVIDIA placed orders, or that the reported target is revenue from NVIDIA. The US$80–US$90 million figure is NN’s 2026 business target, not a reported result or an NVDA forecast. [incoming, item:e2, item:e3]
limitations: The report does not identify the award customers or establish a direct commercial relationship, order, or commitment between NVIDIA and NN.
It does not provide the expansion’s commissioning or production-ramp schedule, output volume, or evidence that the planned capacity is operating.
The basis and realization of NN’s US$80–US$90 million 2026 new-business target are not specified, including what portion, if any, relates to NVIDIA programs.
follow_up: Check NN’s original late-June announcement and subsequent filings for the named award customers, any disclosed NVIDIA relationship, and whether the awards cover NVIDIA-related programs.
Check NN’s subsequent disclosures for installation and ramp timing of the 47 machine centers and for realized business against the 2026 US$80–US$90 million target.
